text: Did you know that this end time Bible prophecy  is happening right in front of your eyes and   nobody is talking about it? All right, let's  see it. The Bible says that when God struck
Lucifer and his angels out of heaven that he  chained some of them underneath the earth. So
the Bible says no such thing, but we do have  a handful of passages that say similar things,
but this creator is squishing them all together  and then adding details that aren't there.   For instance in Isaiah 14 we have the king of  Babylon being rhetorically cast as a presumptuous
deity who is cast down to Sheol. There's no  binding, there are no angels. In Jude 1:6
we have 1 Enoch's retelling of the story of  Genesis 6 with these angels who are disobedient
being chained in darkness, but this is not about  under the earth and there is no casting down and
there is no Satan. In Revelation 12 we have Satan  and their angels being cast down to the earth
where they then run amok. There's no being bound  and it's not under the earth. Satan will be bound
for the thousand years of the millennium according  to Revelation 20, but there are no angels,
no reference to under the earth. Revelation 9  talks about four angels who are bound at the
river Euphrates – not under, but at the Euphrates  river – but these angels are mentioned nowhere
else and not in connection with Satan, unless one  connects them with the four angels of Revelation   7:1 who are holding back the four winds, which  they probably shouldn't. The Bible says that
God chained up some of the angels and put them  underneath the Euphrates river in the middle east.
So the bible says absolutely nothing about anyone  being chained underneath the Euphrates river and
these angels cannot be connected with the angels  of Jude or of 2 Peter because those angels are
said to be chained in gloomy darkness until  the judgment, whereas the angels of Revelation
9 are released to go run amok well before the  judgment. And the prophecy says that once the
Euphrates river dries up that these angels will  be released back unto the earth. The Bible, again,
says no such thing whatsoever. The four angels  are to be released at the Euphrates according to
Revelation 9:14. The drying up of the Euphrates is  a part of the sixth angel pouring out their bowl
in Revelation 16:12 and that's to dry up the  river to make way for the kings of the east.   And at that point they will be given  permission to slaughter one-third of mankind.
So we're back to Revelation 9:15 which has  absolutely nothing to do with the Euphrates   river drying up, which does not happen until  Revelation 16. The river is almost dried up.
Archaeologists are saying that the river could  dry up by the year 2040. If you believe the   bible is true make sure to subscribe now  to keep up with end time bible prophecy.
